chain.title: A Guardian in the End
chain.desc: Explore a Ruined Citadel and defeat an Ender Golem. Recover its Void Core for a weapon project that will eventually join this route to the Nether.

chain.title: Recover the Void Core
chain.desc: Collect the Ender Golem's Void Core. Keep it for a later weapon-fusion project instead of treating it as an interchangeable crafting ingot.

chain.title: At the Citadel's Heart
chain.desc: Prepare for the Ender Guardian deeper in the Ruined Citadel. Read its attack openings and defeat it for the gauntlet branch.

chain.title: The Guardian's Gauntlet
chain.desc: Recover the Gauntlet of Guard. This weapon will later combine with a desert boss reward at the Mechanical Fusion Anvil.

chain.title: The Nether's Foundry
chain.desc: Find the Soul Blacksmith structure and challenge the Netherite Monstrosity. Bring protection against the furnace hazards and leave space to dodge its attacks.

chain.title: A Horn from the Furnace
chain.desc: Collect the Monstrous Horn and inspect the Monstrous Helm recipe. This drop starts an armor upgrade alongside the Infernal Forge weapon route.

chain.title: Armor from the Monstrosity
chain.desc: Craft the Monstrous Helm using the installed recipe. Try its protection before deciding which other bosses to tackle.

chain.title: Bring the Forge Home
chain.desc: Recover the Infernal Forge from the Monstrosity. Keep it intact if you plan to fuse it with a Void Core later.

chain.title: Wake the Ancient Machine
chain.desc: Explore an Ancient Factory and prepare the Harbinger encounter. Bring its activation item and combat supplies shown by the installed mod's guide and recipes.

chain.title: Salvage the Harbinger
chain.desc: Recover Witherite Ingots from the Harbinger. They open an equipment branch and the workstation needed for weapon fusion.

chain.title: A Place to Combine Victories
chain.desc: Craft a Mechanical Fusion Anvil with Witherite. Unlike an ordinary anvil, this workstation performs the mod's weapon-fusion recipes.

chain.title: Join End and Nether
chain.desc: Fuse the Infernal Forge with a Void Core at the Mechanical Fusion Anvil. Two independent boss routes now contribute to one weapon.

chain.title: Search the Sands
chain.desc: Use a Desert Eye to locate the desert expedition. Prepare to explore the Cursed Pyramid rather than requiring another unrelated boss first.

chain.title: The Buried Sovereign
chain.desc: Explore the Cursed Pyramid, prepare its awakening requirements and defeat the Ancient Remnant. Recover the Sandstorm in a Bottle for the gauntlet branch.

chain.title: A Captured Sandstorm
chain.desc: Claim the Sandstorm in a Bottle from the desert boss. This is the missing fusion component for the Gauntlet of Maelstrom.

chain.title: Citadel Meets Pyramid
chain.desc: Fuse the Gauntlet of Guard with the Sandstorm in a Bottle. This goal joins the End and desert routes through a real recipe.

chain.title: Prepare the Burning Arena
chain.desc: Gather Dying Embers and make Burning Ashes. Use them at the Burning Altar when you are ready to summon Ignis.

chain.title: The Burning Duel
chain.desc: Summon Ignis at the Burning Altar and defeat it. Prepare for a long close-range duel before spending the summoning material.

chain.title: Metal from Ignis
chain.desc: Recover Ignitium Ingots for the Ignitium armor branch. Keep enough material for the pieces you intend to upgrade.

chain.title: Armor for the Final Flight
chain.desc: Use the installed upgrade recipe to combine endgame protection with flight. Gather the required armor and elytra before starting.

chain.title: An Offering to the Depths
chain.desc: Assemble an Abyssal Sacrifice and prepare underwater breathing and movement. Bring the offering to the Sunken City's altar.

chain.title: Beneath the Sunken City
chain.desc: Use the sacrifice at the Altar of Abyss and defeat the Leviathan. This aquatic expedition is independent of the desert and Nether routes.

chain.title: Claim the Tides
chain.desc: Recover the Tidal Claws after the Leviathan encounter. Test their movement and attack utility before your next expedition.

chain.title: The Cursed Arena
chain.desc: Find a Frosted Prison and prepare for Maledictus. Its attacks reward watching the arena rather than rushing straight into the boss.

chain.title: A Cursed Trophy Reforged
chain.desc: Gather the Maledictus encounter's materials and craft a Cursium Chestplate using the installed recipe. This finishes a separate high-level armor route.

content_revision: 2026-10-07: explicit branches, operational guidance, no collection filler

coverage.scope: Independent boss expeditions, summon preparation, and genuine multi-boss weapon-fusion goals.
coverage.limitations: Boss availability and summon items vary by Cataclysm version. Data checked against 3.31; unsupported newer encounters are omitted. Named locations are guidance, not fabricated structure-detection tasks.
coverage.verification_detail: Item models, entity language identifiers, dimension data, recipes and bundled guide text where present were inspected; this is data verification, not a Minecraft playthrough.

notes: Each requires list is intentional. Empty lists are independent entry routes. Links describe guided progression or demonstrated recipe/boss gates, not an assertion that every dependency is a game-enforced lock. Runtime scanning still filters unavailable items and entities.
